ops.text: Three stale agent worktrees (`agent-a9bcbdd`, `agent-ad468ea`, `agent-ae3d757`, all at old-history commit `338734c`) held uncommitted spike prototypes against the pre-v14 single-crate layout: a Rust CLI spike (`spike_cli.rs` + Cargo wiring), a core event spike (`spike.rs`), and a Python facade spike (`spike_facade.py` + `__init__`/stub edits). All were preserved as attachments (per-worktree `git diff` patches + the untracked files themselves) before the worktrees were removed during the cargo-artifact history purge. The spikes predate the v14 `rust/crates/core` architecture — treat as historical reference, not revivable branches.
